changes.statement: For the fixed c12 TP8 DeepSeek V4 Flash W4A8 target metadata path, per-request SAS and QLI length tensors make the scalar max-K fallback unnecessary. The opt-in static scalar removes an approximately 8.006 ms/cycle metadata synchronization, passes 8x299-cycle stable-field shadow and formal 48x1024 serving, and raises official median output TPS from 525.417 to 571.681; full AICPU tails are nondeterministic under self-replay.
